scope.process_note: This artifact records post-implementation independent review evidence for tracker #838 and each subissue #839-#846. It does not relabel unsupported PR-body claims as durable pre-merge review. The original pre-merge reviewer conversations were not retained as checked artifacts; that process gap remains explicit.

prompt_boundary: Three independent read-only subagents were each required to inspect the current #838 tracker and every subissue #839-#846 individually at exact merged main bfb5f01f796faffc22296b312ae4affb045e9fd2. Each had to report an eight-row PASS/FAIL matrix covering exact PR/head/merge identity, acceptance evidence and metrics, dependency order, held-out boundary, validation evidence, and support for the three-review requirement; then separately audit tracker checkmarks, the no-go/product-unchanged conclusion, follow-ups #891/#892, #894 ancestry repair, and merged-main CI run 29334394161. Reviewers were read-only and instructed not to coordinate.

major_findings: The implementation PRs contain author assertions of three independent reviews but no durable reviewer-authored or checked record with reviewer identity, exact reviewed state, prompt boundary, findings, dispositions, and validation summary.

accepted_feedback.finding: Squash-merging #893 removed history-bound evidence commits, so the first main-push CI failed even though pre-merge checks passed.
accepted_feedback.resolution: Reopened #846, reverted #838 completion checkmarks, merged #894 with a true two-parent merge commit, verified every required commit as an ancestor, reran three independent repair reviews, and required successful merged-main push CI run 29334394161 before restoring the checkmarks.

accepted_feedback.finding: Existing PR prose did not durably identify the independent whole-work reviews required for each #838 subissue.
accepted_feedback.resolution: Added this post-implementation artifact with exact reviewed state, prompt boundary, canonical reviewer task identities, dispositions, findings, check summaries, and independent per-subissue results. This explicitly records the earlier durability gap rather than representing these reviews as pre-merge evidence.

follow_up_review.requirement: Three independent reviewers must verify this artifact accurately represents their reviews, that the accepted process finding is resolved without rewriting history, and that no new technical or evidence defect was introduced.
